question: Which 3.1.32 entry pushes an application page (page_goto)?
prototype_hypothesis: page_goto(key, start_data, 0, 0) resolves the page key with the page-manager registry and runs the stock transition; it is the body that logs the tag goto_page_no_check_stacktop.
callsite_evidence: The only reference to the string "goto_page_no_check_stacktop" (0x2c70c7dc) is inside sub_C4B456C (0xc4b456c), which also logs "Please register this page:%lu!" from the pagemanager tag.

The ported record pointed at 0xc45b588, whose body is lvx_pagemanager_prelaunch_check: it resolves the app, defers or ignores the prelaunch and returns without showing any page. The o66 build hit the same mistake with pagemanager show_app.
The body calls sub_C45A3D4 (current page), then sub_C45EA4C for the transition and sub_C45BB5C to enter the page, i.e. the same shape as the o66 goto_page_no_check_stacktop at 0xc4e0208.
ownership_analysis: No ownership claimed; the page descriptors stay owned by the Supervisor.
unsafe_assumptions: Static evidence only; the emulator run that motivated the correction is not device evidence.
recommended_probe: Rebuild the n66 Supervisor and confirm the Manager page opens on Mirage.
